"Dry broken wood, a strong draft, and a narrow crawl make fire here a consequence rather than decoration."
"A new smolder can be stamped out or doused with the real bottled water. Once open flame takes hold, a bottle is no fire hose: retreat by the wide eastern passage instead of crawling west through concentrated smoke."
